subject: I've been playing most nights
author: Linkster
body:
although I really want to play something else 1vs100 has me well and truly hooked.  There is sopething about general knowledge and trivia shows that I love and can't get enough of.  I was only ever in the crowd tonight but with Silvers being allowed to play this weekend the chances of getting to be in the mob or even the one will be slimmer as more people will be playing.

Good luck to all those who get in a winning position but to me the scoring seems broken as on the last game I was less than 100 points from a top 10 place.  1 question later that I answered correctly and quickly and I was 5k points behind the top 10.

subject: 1 vs 100 for the masses
author: Xandu
body:
I really hope that Microsoft removes the region lock on this game so people from other countries than the UK and USA can play the game.
